description: Analyze email subject and/or body text for spam trigger words and get a 0-100 spam score, a risk level (Low/Medium/High Risk), and a per-trigger breakdown. Costs 1 spam-checker credit per successful request. Use before sending marketing/transactional email to predict deliverability. At least one of subject or content must be provided.

content.description: The email body text to analyze.

subject.description: The email subject line to analyze.

name: check_spam_score
